title: Anthus One customer portal as a separate app in Prospectus
description: Separate application (portal/index.html, src/portal, vite.portal.config.ts, dist-portal) for one.anth.us: sign-in, identity confirmation, workspace switcher, Home, Apps, People and bots, Settings on the existing customer account routes; Usage, Plan and billing, API keys and workspace creation shown as not yet available. npm run dev:portal serves it at localhost:5421 against the deployed backend. Interim sign-in through the Prospectus Cognito client (APP_ORIGINS). Remaining: hosting one.anth.us (Amplify + DNS), own pool decision, invitations and workspace creation. Spec: features/anthus-one-portal.feature.

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-10-21: live at https://one.anth.us. #56 (portal app), #68 (S3 + CloudFront hosting as CDK, no second Amplify app), #69 (Google-direct sign-in), #71 (hosting enabled, accounts BFF recorded; Amplify job 69). Ryan signed in and confirmed it works. Remaining portal features (self-service create UI, members, invitations, product registry) are tracked in their own issues.
